gaps.root_cause: a target_position order that becomes active while an earlier order on the same (strategy, symbol, contract) is still live is sized from the FILLED target (target_positions) only; Oracle v1 sizes it from position + live pending orders. In the G16 scenario Core turns target 0 into a no-op, then fills the delayed BUY and ends LONG 1000 against a latest target of 0; Oracle sells at 09:20, buys at 09:25 and ends flat
gaps.proposed_minimum_correction: compute the delta once, when the order becomes active (order_time), as target_position - (filled position + remaining signed qty of still-live earlier orders with the same target_key); keep the order's qty fixed after
gaps.adapter_guard: known_divergences() refuses any run in which an order activates while an earlier one is live (B01-B12: 0 hits; probe: hit)
gaps.resolution: fixed in Core 50ea3bf: oracle probe PASS, K17 probe SUPPORTED; root_cause above describes the defect as found in 298956f

gaps.root_cause: DAY expiry is inclusive: a bar with bar_start == expiry (the first session_close after order_time) is still a candidate. With back-to-back sessions (close 09:20 = next open 09:20) a session-1 DAY order fills on the opening bar of session 2; Oracle v1 expires it (skips bars with ts >= expires_at)
gaps.proposed_minimum_correction: make the boundary exclusive (`<`) in both places; ORDER_EXPIRED at expiry stays as is
gaps.adapter_guard: known_divergences() refuses any run with a fill at bar_start >= its DAY expiry
gaps.resolution: fixed in Core 50ea3bf: oracle probe PASS, K14b probe SUPPORTED; root_cause above describes the defect as found in 298956f
